name: @bongtu/wallet-web
description: bongtu public wallet PoC — a self-custody MetaMask wallet (SPEC §7 public app): derive a BabyJubJub spending key from an eth_signTypedData_v4 signature over a domain-separated struct (deterministic), show balance from the arbiter indexer (signed /notes) or a /events trial-decrypt fallback, and assemble + prove + submit transfer / withdraw. Imports unbuilt @bongtu/* workspace source directly so the crypto is byte-identical.
